name: Koiiro no Enogu
source:
Makoto lives in a dormitory at a certain school. He likes solitude, so his daily life is nothing but pain. One day a transfer student shows up and stirs everyone's emotions. This is a story of adolescent boys who cannot measure the distance of interpersonal relationships.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
